text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Powers of Attorney (Fees) Regulations. Fees

The fees to be paid in respect of proceedings under the Act shall be as set out in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE (regulation 2) FEES Subject of proceedings Amount

(a) Deposit of any instrument or copy of an instrument as is $50 referred to in section 3(1)

(b) For inspection and search of the register under $3 section 8(2), for every quarter of an hour

(c) For office copy of any document deposited $10

(d) For searches conducted under section 10, for every quarter $3 of an hour
